info.name: Accounting Integration API - Admin
info.description:
Two-way accounting sync API, full set.

**Internal use. Contains login, token minting and admin calls. Do not share this file outside your team; give partners the Partner collection instead.**

## Security rules
- Keep tokens only in an environment's **current value**. Never put them in a collection, a shared workspace, or a screenshot.
- Never export or commit an environment that has tokens in it.
- Requests are blocked unless base_url is https (plain http is allowed only for localhost and .test hosts).
- Requests that change data are blocked until you set allow_writes to true. Test on a test tenant first.
- Tokens don't expire on their own. Revoke them when a person or a machine no longer needs access.
- If a token may have leaked, revoke it straight away and check the sync log.

exec: // Safety checks that run before every request. They can only stop a request, never change it.
if (!baseUrl) { stop('Set base_url in the environment.'); }
if (!/^https:\/\//i.test(baseUrl) && !isLocal) { stop('base_url must use https:// so tokens are not sent in clear text. Plain http is allowed only for localhost and .test hosts.'); }
if (!String(pm.variables.get('tenant_slug') || '').trim()) { stop('Set tenant_slug in the environment.'); }
stop('This request changes data, and allow_writes is not "true" in the environment. Use a test tenant first.');

request.description: Saves a full-access token to admin_token and clears admin_password. This token can do anything the user can do across the ERP, so never share it. Log out when finished. Limit: 5 attempts a minute.

exec: try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { /* not JSON */ }
if (pm.response.code < 300) { const value = body?.token; if (value !== undefined && value !== null) { pm.environment.set('admin_token', String(value)); } }

request.description: product is tally or custom. Saves the new id to connection_id. Always set export_from, or all journal history goes out.

request.description: Use this first if a token may have leaked.

A token acts as whoever mints it, so log in as the dedicated service user, not an owner. Works for this connection and this API only. Shown once; saved to connector_token. Send it to a partner through a password manager or other secret-sharing tool, never email or chat.

exec: try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { /* not JSON */ }
if (pm.response.code < 300) { const value = body?.data?.token; if (value !== undefined && value !== null) { pm.environment.set('connector_token', String(value)); } }
if (pm.response.code < 300) { const value = body?.data?.id; if (value !== undefined && value !== null) { pm.environment.set('token_id', String(value)); } }

item.name: Map external ledger to local ledger

Send groups, then ledgers, then vouchers. Up to 500 items. Idempotency-Key is a new GUID here so each click is a new request; a real connector must store its key and reuse it when retrying.

item.name: 8. Security checks
item.description: Each request here should be refused. A pass means the API refused it. The idempotency checks create one harmless test ledger, so use a test tenant.

item.name: Connector token cannot reach the rest of the ERP
Connector token cannot reach another connection
Connector token lists only its own connection

exec: pm.test('Only this connection is listed', function () { const ids = (pm.response.json().data || []).map(function (c) { return String(c.id); }); pm.expect(ids).to.eql([String(pm.environment.get('connection_id'))]); });
pm.test('Status is 401 or 403 or 404', function () { pm.expect([401, 403, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

item.name: Idempotency: same send is replayed, not repeated
Idempotency: same key with other data is refused

request.description: Works only for tokens minted by the logged-in user.
Posted journals are not affected.
Revokes the login token on the server and clears admin_token.
